title: Slovakian Style Pork Roast with Indian Flair
description: A fusion of Slovakian and Indian flavors, this pork roast recipe is marinated in a blend of spices and roasted to perfection.
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together garam masala, cumin, turmeric, coriander powder, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper.
Rub the spice mix all over the pork roast, making sure to coat it evenly.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and sear the pork roast until nicely browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Transfer the pork roast to a roasting pan and roast in the preheated oven for 20 minutes.
Reduce the oven temperature to 180°C (350°F) and continue roasting for another 30-40 minutes, or until the internal temperature reaches 63°C (145°F).
Remove the pork roast from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
Serve with a side of your choice, such as naan bread or a simple salad.
